propositions: rebar-debug skill closes defect tickets without recording the originating ticket that introduced the defect, preventing measurement of defect escape rate

the automatic blame fallback attributes defects to authors of files touched by the fix rather than to authors of the change that caused the defect, and cannot detect cases where the fix site differs from the cause site (unmet obligations, missed consumer updates)

Phase 1 Stage 3 must add a required attribution step that identifies the introducing change by blaming implicated lines, walking carrier commits, and recovering the ticket from commit metadata before RCA writeback
the skill must detect when the fix site is not the cause site using date tests and producer-side history search to recover unmet-obligation defects
the bug close must include --caused-by=<origin-id> flag to prevent the automatic blame derivation from adding a second guessed caused_by edge
rebar-debug and rebar-implement skills must bootstrap worktrees with make worktree name=<branch> and ensure the worktree venv is on PATH to avoid pre-commit hook failures
